subject: CoInteropFabric+ protocol-neutral capability, authority, intent, receiver and evidence routing
tests: Evaluate one bounded work object through two replaceable transport projections without changing semantic identity
Verify transport availability never elevates authority
Report projection loss and receiver evidence separately from tool-schema conformance
expected_benefit: Reduce protocol lock-in while keeping intent, capability, authority, receiver and evidence as separate relations.
risks: Transport adapters may be mistaken for ontology or authority
Term proliferation may duplicate existing route doctrine
wake_conditions: A new transport or protocol materially changes route quality
A current adapter creates semantic or authority ambiguity
